## Task 1 – The setup check

**In your workspace.** Run `source("R/check_setup.R")` until it reports no failure, and render `index.qmd` once. Then read the four scenarios of the warm-up in the box of Task 1 of `index.qmd`, and fill in their gaps.

If your installation fails, run the cells of the setup check in the deck or in the browser lab, and carry on there for the rest of the day.
